mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market that triggers economic slowdown concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime (indicated by declining industrial production), a further drop in INDPRO signals worsening economic conditions, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle contraction periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A reading of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, signaling economic weakness that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5.0% and unemployment rises above 4.8%, it indicates a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS>5.0% and UNRATE>4.8% fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1800 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1800.
